description: This file implements a class 'NsswitchReader' that reads and parses the system's nsswitch configuration file to determine DNS and hostname resolution settings.

classes.name: NsswitchReader::ServiceSpecification
classes.description: Represents a service (like 'dns' or 'files') and its associated actions as parsed from the nsswitch configuration.

methods.name: NsswitchReader::ReadAndParseHosts
methods.description: Reads the nsswitch configuration file and parses the 'hosts' database entries into service specifications.
